quand: As soon as the payment for an order is confirmed, with the details of the pieces ordered.
preheader: Your piece will be made for you, to order, by French artisans.

suivi.description: The order tracking link (no account needed)

debut.description: The earliest expected day for the making to be finished

fin.description: The latest expected day for the making to be finished

certificats.description: The link to the certificate of authenticity of each piece, when it is already online

codes.description: The account link code of each piece, to pass on if it is a gift

blocs.texte:
Dear {prenom},

Your order {commande} has just reached the atelier. Nothing is made in advance: your piece is made for you, to order, by French artisans.
Allow {delai} for the making. We expect to finish it between {debut} and {fin}.
The certificate of authenticity of each piece is already online, linked to your account if you have one: {certificats}
If you are giving a piece as a gift, pass on its account link code with it: {codes}
We will write to you at each step: when the piece goes into the making, when it is ready, then on the day it leaves. You can follow your order here: {suivi}

Until very soon,
The Awrea Paris atelier
